_comment: AEGIS Executor configuration — single source of truth for all scoring tables and tunable parameters. All weights, thresholds, and lookup tables live here. No magic numbers elsewhere.

allowlist._comment: The 3 allowlisted actions. Any other action string must be refused.

safety_risk_table._comment: Per-action risk breakdowns. blast_risk=how far the blast radius extends, data_loss_risk=chance of permanent data loss, overhead_risk=operational overhead. All in [0..25] each; sum max=75 → Safety min=25.

recovery_table._comment: Per-fault-type recovery probability 0..100. Used as Recovery score in composite.

scoring._comment: Score = safety_weight*Safety + recovery_weight*Recovery. Refuse if Safety < safety_threshold.

health._comment: Healthy = latency < 2x baseline AND no active failures within verification_window_sec.

actuator._comment: Real URL and HMAC secret come from env vars. Never hard-coded.

audit._comment: Append-only JSONL file. Never log secrets.
